products.name: Insulated Flexible Duct Systems
products.description: Manufactures and distributes insulated HVAC flexible duct systems for air distribution in residential and commercial buildings. Production involves physical manufacturing of ducting materials and insulation.

products.name: Wire and Cable Solutions
products.description: Manufactures and markets bare and insulated copper and aluminum wire, aluminum-clad steel, copper-clad steel, building wire, underground power cable, ground rod, and medium voltage cable for utility, municipal, telecommunication, and electrical distribution markets. products.name: Specialty Copper, Copper Alloy, and Aluminum Tube
products.description: Manufactures specialty copper, copper alloy, and aluminum tube for industrial and OEM applications, involving precision manufacturing processes for specialized uses.

products.name: Valves, Fluid Control Solutions, and Gas Train Assemblies
products.description: Manufactures brass, aluminum, and stainless steel valves, fluid control systems, and gas train assemblies for compressed gas, pharmaceutical, construction, and gas appliance markets. Products are manufactured and assembled for industrial use.

products.name: Coaxial Heat Exchangers and Twisted Tubes
products.description: Manufactures coaxial heat exchangers and twisted tubes for HVAC, geothermal, refrigeration, swimming pool heat pump, marine, ice machine, commercial boiler, and heat reclamation markets. Production involves specialized tube forming and assembly.

products.name: Acquisition of Oil and Gas Working Interests
products.description: Acquisition of high working interest positions in actively producing oil and gas fields, primarily in the Permian Basin, through disciplined evaluation and purchase of leasehold and producing properties from third parties. products.name: Disposable Protective Apparel

products.name: Face Shields and Eye Protection

products.description: High-voltage contactors, fuses, junction boxes, and related electrical protection components and systems for automotive applications, designed and manufactured to protect vehicle systems from high-voltage power sources, ensuring safety and performance in both ICE and electrified vehicles.

products.name: Industrial Sensors and Sensor Solutions
products.description: Application-specific sensors, including position, pressure, temperature, gas leak detection, and current sensors, manufactured for industrial and commercial OEMs in markets such as HVAC, appliances, energy, and data/telecom, enabling system optimization, safety, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Industrial Electrical Protection Devices
products.description: Bimetal electromechanical controls, circuit breakers, switches, and relays manufactured for use in industrial, appliance, HVAC, lighting, and data/telecom equipment, providing critical safety and operational protection for electrical systems.

products.name: Industrial Power Management and Conversion Systems
products.description: Energy storage systems, high-voltage contactors/fuses, rectifiers, frequency converters, and power conversion systems for industrial applications, including renewable energy generation, microgrids, and grid power delivery, manufactured to optimize energy efficiency and reliability.

products.name: Aerospace, Defense, and Commercial Equipment Sensors and Controls
products.description: Custom sensors (pressure, temperature, position, gas leak detection) and operator controls manufactured for aerospace, defense, and commercial equipment OEMs, integrated into mission-critical systems for aircraft, on-road trucks, construction, and agriculture equipment.

products.name: Aerospace, Defense, and Commercial Equipment Electrical Protection and Power Systems
products.description: High-voltage contactors, distribution units, battery management systems, charging inlet modules, bimetal controls, circuit breakers, switches, relays, and energy storage systems manufactured for aerospace, defense, and commercial vehicle applications, ensuring electrical safety and system reliability.

products.name: Oil and Gas Production and Sales

products.description: Development of carbon capture and storage projects, including potential CO2 storage and direct air capture hubs, leveraging deep geologic formations and existing wells to sequester CO2 for third parties. products.description: Offers loans secured by commercial real estate, including non-owner occupied, multifamily, owner-occupied properties, and construction loans for residential and commercial development projects. products.description: Provides residential mortgage loans, including fixed and variable rate, jumbo, and interest-only mortgages, primarily in New Jersey, New York, and Florida. products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans including direct and indirect automobile loans, home equity loans and lines of credit, and personal loans. Products are delivered through branch networks, third-party advisors, and dealer relationships, requiring both digital and in-person processes.

products.name: Deposit and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides traditional consumer and commercial deposit products, including checking, savings, and money market accounts, as well as treasury management and payments solutions. products.name: Orthopedic Trauma Solutions
products.description: Devices and systems for the treatment of orthopedic fractures and limb reconstruction, including fracture plating, intramedullary nailing, external fixation, compression screw technologies, and limb lengthening systems. products.name: Hip and Knee Arthroplasty Solutions
products.description: Implantable devices for hip and knee replacement surgeries, including partial and primary hip systems (modular cemented and cementless stems, acetabular cups, femoral heads, liners) and knee systems (partial, cruciate retaining, posterior stabilized, revision options). These are manufactured implants delivered for surgical reconstruction of degenerative or failed joints.

products.name: Regenerative Biologic Products
products.description: Regenerative biologic products such as allografts and synthetic alternatives, used as adjunctive treatments in combination with implant hardware for musculoskeletal surgeries. These products are processed from human tissue or manufactured synthetically and delivered for surgical use.

products.name: Spinal Cord Stimulation Therapy
products.description: Implantable neuromodulation devices and platforms (e.g., HFX™ SCS, Senza® SCS system) for the treatment of chronic pain, including back, limb, and diabetic neuropathy pain. These are manufactured electronic devices implanted in patients and supported by patient and physician tools.

products.name: Neuromonitoring Services (IONM)
products.description: Intraoperative neuromonitoring services using proprietary software-driven nerve detection and avoidance technology, including onsite and remote monitoring during spinal and brain-related surgeries. These services are delivered by trained personnel using specialized hardware and software platforms.

products.name: Enabling Technologies (Imaging, Navigation, and Robotics)
products.description: Advanced computer-assisted systems for surgical imaging, navigation, and robotics (INR), including platforms such as ExcelsiusGPS®, Excelsius3D™, ExcelsiusHub®, ExcelsiusFlex®, ExcelsiusXR®, and Surgimap® software. These are manufactured capital equipment and software solutions designed to enhance surgical accuracy, planning, and workflow in spine, cranial, and orthopedic procedures.

products.name: Respiratory Vaccines
products.description: mRNA-based vaccines for respiratory diseases, including COVID-19 (Spikevax, mNEXSPIKE), RSV (mRESVIA), and seasonal influenza. These are manufactured using proprietary mRNA and lipid nanoparticle (LNP) technology and delivered via injection, requiring large-scale, regulated biomanufacturing and distribution.

products.name: Combination Vaccines
products.description: mRNA-based vaccines that combine protection against multiple respiratory viruses (e.g., flu+COVID, RSV+hMPV), produced using the same mRNA/LNP manufacturing platform and delivered via injection. These products are in late-stage development and regulatory review.

products.name: Pandemic and Public Health Vaccines
products.description: mRNA-based vaccines targeting pandemic threats and public health concerns, such as pandemic influenza (H5), Nipah virus, and Mpox. These are developed using the mRNA/LNP platform and manufactured at scale for rapid response to emerging threats.

products.name: Latent Virus Vaccines and Therapeutics
products.description: mRNA-based vaccines and therapeutics targeting latent viruses such as CMV, EBV, and HIV. These products are designed to prevent infection or treat associated diseases, using proprietary mRNA sequences and LNP delivery, and are in various stages of clinical development.

products.name: Enteric and Bacterial Vaccines
products.description: mRNA-based vaccines for enteric viruses (e.g., norovirus) and bacterial diseases (e.g., Lyme disease), produced using the mRNA/LNP platform and delivered via injection. These are in clinical development for broad population protection.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: mRNA-based individualized cancer therapeutics, including personalized neoantigen therapies (e.g., intismeran autogene/mRNA-4157), cancer antigen therapies, T-cell engagers, and cell therapy enhancers. These are manufactured using automated, patient-specific workflows and delivered via injection, often in combination with other immunotherapies.

products.name: Rare Disease Therapeutics
products.description: mRNA-based therapeutics for rare genetic diseases, such as propionic acidemia (mRNA-3927), methylmalonic acidemia (mRNA-3705), and cystic fibrosis (mRNA-3692/VX-522). These are delivered via intravenous or nebulized administration and require specialized, regulated manufacturing for clinical and commercial supply.

products.name: Gaming FinTech and Payment Solutions
products.description: Provision of payment solutions for the gaming industry, including issuing prepaid debit cards and managing electronic prepaid access programs for digital gaming and consumer wallet/app operators. products.name: Consumer Deposit Products
products.description: A range of consumer deposit accounts, including checking and savings, offered through physical branches and digital channels, with FDIC insurance and premium service focus. Requires regulated banking infrastructure and customer service.

products.name: Credit Card Services
products.description: Issuance of the GBank Visa Signature® credit card, primarily targeting online gaming and sports betting users, with rewards and digital wallet compatibility. Delivered via card networks and digital platforms, requiring regulatory compliance.

Manufactured in collaboration with OEMs and designed for mass production and easy installation, these burners reduce NOx emissions and improve operational efficiency.

products.name: Boiler Burner Technology
products.description: Burners based on ClearSign CoreTM technology designed for use in fire tube and water tube boilers for industrial, commercial, and institutional applications. These burners are manufactured for both new installations and retrofits, focusing on ultra-low NOx emissions and improved energy efficiency.

products.name: Flaring Burner and Flare Systems
products.description: Flare burners and complete or partial flare systems incorporating ClearSign CoreTM technology, designed to combust waste gases with extremely low NOx emissions. These systems include controls and stack elements and are used in oil production, gas processing, and other industrial applications.

products.name: Hydrogen Process Burners
products.description: Industrial burners capable of combusting pure hydrogen fuel while maintaining ultra-low NOx emissions, developed using ClearSign CoreTM technology. These burners are targeted at decarbonizing industrial heating processes and are supported by DOE-funded R&D.

products.name: Flame Sensing Products (ClearSign Eye)
products.description: Electrical flame sensors for industrial combustion equipment, including burners, flares, and thermal oxidizers. The ClearSign Eye sensors are designed for reliable flame detection without direct flame contact, suitable for both retrofit and new installations, and are being developed for broader applications including transportation.

products.name: Thermal Oxidizer Burners
products.description: Burners and related systems for thermal oxidizers, utilizing ClearSign CoreTM technology to control emissions and improve efficiency in waste gas destruction applications. These are offered as part of bids and projects for industrial customers seeking emissions control solutions.

products.name: OTSG Burners for Enhanced Oil Recovery
products.description: Burners based on ClearSign CoreTM and Duplex technology for Once Through Steam Generators (OTSGs) used in enhanced oil recovery. These burners are designed to improve efficiency and reduce emissions in steam generation for oil production.

products.description: Operation and distribution of branded television channels (e.g., ABC, Disney, FX, National Geographic, ESPN) domestically and internationally, delivered via cable, satellite, and broadcast infrastructure, generating revenue from affiliate fees and advertising.

products.name: Direct-to-Consumer Streaming Services
products.description: Subscription-based and ad-supported digital streaming platforms (Disney+, Hulu, ESPN DTC) offering on-demand and live entertainment and sports content, delivered over the internet to global subscribers.

products.description: Licensing of Disney intellectual property (characters, brands) for use on merchandise, and direct sale of branded products through online and physical retail stores, as well as publishing of books and comics.

products.description: Insurance coverage for commercial property risks, including buildings and contents, often with catastrophe exposure. products.description: Personal lines insurance for high-value homes, providing property and liability coverage for individuals with significant assets. Underwritten for unique or higher-risk personal exposures.

products.name: Personal Insurance
products.description: Personal lines insurance products, including homeowners and manufactured housing coverage, underwritten for hard-to-place personal risks and distributed through brokers.

products.name: Perception and Autonomy Software
products.description: Integrated perception software platforms (including SENTINEL and custom application software) that process lidar data for object detection, classification, and autonomous system control, delivered as standalone or embedded solutions for automotive, industrial, and defense markets.

products.name: Engineering and Development Services
products.description: Custom engineering services, including development of application-specific software and integration support, provided to OEMs and industrial customers to tailor lidar and perception solutions to their needs.

products.name: Augmented Reality Microdisplay Modules
products.description: Microdisplay engines and MEMS modules for head-mounted augmented reality (AR) headsets, based on proprietary laser beam scanning technology, delivered as components to consumer and military sectors.

products.name: TSHA-102 Gene Therapy for Rett Syndrome
products.description: A one-time, intrathecally delivered AAV9-based gene therapy designed to address the genetic root cause of Rett syndrome by delivering a functional MECP2 gene to CNS cells. Manufactured using proprietary processes and delivered via lumbar intrathecal injection in clinical and, if approved, commercial settings.

products.name: TSHA-113 Gene Therapy for Tauopathies
products.description: A one-time, intrathecally delivered AAV9-based gene therapy that packages a tau-specific miRNA to target all six isoforms of tau mRNA, aiming to reduce tau protein production in the CNS for the treatment of tauopathies such as MAPT-associated frontotemporal dementia, progressive supranuclear palsy, corticobasal degeneration, and Alzheimer's disease. Currently in preclinical development.

products.name: TSHA-114 Gene Therapy for Fragile X Syndrome
products.description: A one-time, intrathecally delivered AAV-based gene therapy delivering an FMR1-encoding transgene to restore FMRP expression in the CNS for the treatment of Fragile X syndrome. Currently in preclinical development with proof-of-concept animal studies completed.

products.description: Management and distribution of closed-end funds, which are publicly traded investment vehicles listed on the New York Stock Exchange, offered in multiple asset classes. These require ongoing portfolio management, regulatory compliance, and exchange listing.

products.name: Retail Separate Accounts
products.description: Provision of individually managed investment accounts for retail investors, including intermediary-sold managed accounts and wealth management accounts, tailored to client needs and delivered through financial intermediaries or directly by wealth advisors. Requires portfolio customization and client advisory services.

products.name: Institutional Accounts
products.description: Management of separate and commingled investment accounts for institutional clients such as corporations, retirement funds, and endowments, including subadvisory and collateral management services. Involves customized portfolio management and regulatory compliance for large-scale clients.

products.name: Fund Administration Services
products.description: Provision of administrative services to investment funds, including record keeping, regulatory filings, compliance, client service, and supervision of service providers. Delivered as a regulated service requiring specialized personnel and systems.

products.name: Shareholder Services
products.description: Provision of shareholder services for U.S. retail funds, including maintaining shareholder accounts, processing transactions, and preparing filings. Requires dedicated operational infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Broker-Dealer Services
products.description: Operation of a registered broker-dealer serving as principal underwriter and distributor of funds, providing market advisory services, and managing a qualified tuition plan (529 plan). Requires regulatory registration and compliance with FINRA and SEC rules.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing Services
products.description: Provides gathering, compression, treating, and cryogenic processing of natural gas using an extensive pipeline network and centralized processing complexes in the Permian Basin. Delivered through physical infrastructure and regulated operations.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Stabilization and Transportation Services
products.description: Offers stabilization and transportation of NGLs via owned and operated pipelines connecting processing complexes to major takeaway pipelines and markets. Requires regulated pipeline infrastructure and physical handling of NGLs.

products.name: Crude Oil Gathering, Stabilization, Storage, and Transportation Services
products.description: Provides gathering, stabilization, storage, and transportation of crude oil through a network of pipelines, terminals, and storage facilities in the Texas Delaware Basin. Delivered via physical assets and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Produced Water Gathering and Disposal Services
products.description: Offers gathering and disposal of produced water from oil and gas operations using dedicated pipeline systems and permitted disposal facilities. Requires physical infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Pipeline Transportation Services (Natural Gas, NGLs, and Crude Oil)
products.description: Transports natural gas, NGLs, and crude oil within the Permian Basin and to the U.S. Gulf Coast and Mexico via owned and equity-interest pipelines. Involves large-scale, regulated pipeline infrastructure and long-term contracts.

products.name: Digital Accessibility Platform (SaaS)
products.description: A subscription-based software-as-a-service platform that uses patented machine-learning/AI-driven technology to automatically test, fix, and monitor websites and applications for accessibility compliance, delivered digitally and requiring no fundamental changes to website architecture.

products.name: Human-Assisted Accessibility Services
products.description: Expert-driven services including periodic auditing, custom fixes, and human-assisted technological testing to address accessibility issues that cannot be resolved by automation alone, delivered by certified accessibility experts.

products.name: PDF Remediation Services
products.description: Services to remediate and make PDF documents accessible, ensuring compliance with accessibility standards, delivered as a specialized digital service.

products.name: Mobile Application Accessibility and Audit Reporting Services
products.description: Services focused on auditing and reporting the accessibility of mobile applications, helping customers achieve compliance for their mobile digital assets.

products.name: Legal Support Services for Accessibility Compliance
products.description: Support services that assist customers in mitigating legal risks related to digital accessibility, including guidance and documentation to address compliance with relevant laws and regulations.

products.name: Crude Oil and Refined Products Transportation Services
products.description: Pipeline, marine, rail, and truck transportation of crude oil, refined products, other hydrocarbon-based products, and renewables, delivered via a network of pipelines, barges, and associated infrastructure. Services are provided under long-term, fee-based contracts to both affiliated and third-party customers.

products.name: Terminaling and Storage Services
products.description: Provision of storage and terminaling for crude oil, refined products, renewables, and other hydrocarbons at tank farms, caverns, refinery tanks, and marine terminals. Includes blending, additization, and handling services, with capacity-based and fee-for-service agreements.

products.name: Fuels Distribution Services
products.description: Scheduling, marketing, and distribution of refined products (including renewables) to retail locations and other end users, primarily on behalf of affiliated customers, using an extensive logistics network. Revenue is generated based on product volumes sold each month.

products.name: Inland Marine Transportation Services
products.description: Operation of an inland marine business transporting crude oil, refined products, and other hydrocarbons via boats and barges on inland waterways, under fee-for-capacity contracts with customers.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering, Treating, and Processing Services
products.description: Gathering, treating, and processing of natural gas from wellhead to market, including removal of contaminants and extraction of natural gas liquids (NGLs), using a network of gathering systems and processing complexes. Services are provided under various contract types to producers.

products.name: Natural Gas and NGL Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of natural gas and NGLs via pipelines from processing/fractionation facilities to downstream markets, including both interstate and intrastate services, under regulated and fee-based arrangements.

products.name: NGL Fractionation, Storage, and Marketing Services
products.description: Fractionation of mixed NGL streams into individual components (ethane, propane, butanes, natural gasoline), storage of NGLs, and marketing of NGL products to end-use markets, using fractionation facilities and storage infrastructure.

products.name: Merchant Financial Solutions
products.description: An integrated suite of financial products for merchants of all sizes, including payment acceptance (merchant acquiring), POS software and hardware, cash management and digitalization, business lending, and access to alternative digital products (prepaid airtime, data, electricity, gaming, bill payments, international money transfers, and supplier-enabled payments). Delivered via physical devices, digital accounts, and cloud-connected infrastructure.

products.name: Consumer Financial Solutions
products.description: A suite of banking, credit, and insurance products for underserved consumers, including low-cost transactional bank accounts (with debit card, mobile app, and USSD access), short-term unsecured personal loans, funeral insurance, and secure payout solutions for payroll and government grants. Delivered through digital onboarding, physical cards, and digital/mobile channels.

products.name: Enterprise Payment and Utility Solutions
products.description: Payment and utility management solutions for enterprises, including integration technology for prepaid solutions (airtime, electricity, gaming), bill payment platforms, submetering administration for prepaid electricity meters, and proprietary payment switch technology with ancillary security and tokenization services. Delivered via software platforms, hardware, and network integrations with billers, utilities, and banks.

products.name: Grocery Products
products.description: A wide range of food and beverage items, including fresh, packaged, and prepared foods, sold through physical stores and digital channels. Products are sourced from third-party suppliers and company-owned manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Pharmacy Services and Prescription Drugs
products.description: In-store pharmacy services including prescription medications, over-the-counter drugs, and health consultations, delivered by licensed pharmacists at in-store locations and through digital channels.

products.name: Health and Beauty Care Products
products.description: A variety of health, wellness, and beauty products sold in stores and online, sourced from third-party suppliers and company brands.

products.name: General Merchandise
products.description: Non-food consumer goods such as household items, seasonal products, and other general merchandise sold through stores and digital platforms.

products.name: Fuel Sales
products.description: Retail sale of gasoline and other fuels at branded fuel centers located adjacent to or near retail stores.

products.name: Coffee Shop Services
products.description: Branded in-store coffee shop services offering beverages and snacks, operated within retail locations.

products.name: Vaccination Services
products.description: Administration of vaccines and immunizations provided by licensed pharmacists at in-store pharmacies.

products.name: Digital Grocery and Delivery Services
products.description: Online ordering and home delivery of groceries and other products, fulfilled through company platforms and third-party partners, leveraging in-store inventory and dedicated fulfillment operations.

products.name: Curbside Pickup Services
products.description: Drive Up & Go curbside pickup of online grocery orders, fulfilled by in-store staff for customer convenience.

products.name: Private Label (Own Brands) Products
products.description: A portfolio of nearly 14,000 unique private label food and non-food products, some manufactured in company-owned facilities and others sourced from third parties, sold exclusively in company stores and online.

products.name: Retail Media and Digital Marketing Services
products.description: Digital marketing and advertising services offered to business partners through the Albertsons Media Collective platform, leveraging customer data and digital reach for targeted campaigns.

products.name: Full Spectrum Flow Cytometry Instruments
products.description: Physically manufactured, high-multiplexing flow cytometry instruments (e.g., Cytek Aurora, Aurora Evo, Northern Lights, Aurora CS) using proprietary Full Spectrum Profiling (FSP) technology for high-resolution, high-content single-cell analysis. Delivered as benchtop hardware with integrated software.

products.name: Cell Sorting Instruments
products.description: Physically manufactured cell sorters (e.g., Cytek Aurora CS system) leveraging FSP technology to isolate living cell populations for downstream studies. Delivered as hardware with real-time unmixing and sorting capabilities.

products.name: Conventional and Imaging Flow Cytometry Instruments
products.description: Physically manufactured conventional flow cytometers and imaging flow cytometers (e.g., Amnis ImageStream, Guava Muse, Guava easyCyte, DxP Athena) for cell analysis and morphology studies. Includes both entry-level and advanced systems, delivered as benchtop hardware with supporting software.

products.name: Automated Sample Preparation and Loading Systems
products.description: Physically manufactured automation devices (e.g., Cytek Orion reagent cocktail preparation system, Automated Micro-Sampling System, Automated Sample Loader System) that automate reagent cocktail preparation and sample loading for flow cytometry workflows. Delivered as hardware for laboratory automation.

products.name: Flow Cytometry Reagents and Kits
products.description: Manufactured consumable reagents and assay kits (e.g., cFluor reagents, immunoprofiling kits, Tonbo, Amnis, and Guava-branded reagents) for use with flow cytometry instruments. Includes fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies and multi-color panels for cell identification and analysis.

products.name: Flow Cytometry and Imaging Software
products.description: Proprietary software platforms (e.g., SpectroFlo, InCyte, IDEAS, Amnis AI, SpectroPrep, Cytek Cloud) for instrument control, data acquisition, analysis, and workflow management in flow cytometry and imaging applications. Delivered as digital software, often embedded or cloud-based.

products.name: Instrument Service and Support
products.description: Comprehensive service offerings including installation, maintenance, technical support, and training for all instrument product lines. Delivered through in-person and remote human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: PIPE-791 (LPA1R Antagonist Therapies)
products.description: A portfolio of novel, brain-penetrant, small molecule LPA1R antagonists, including PIPE-791, developed for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), chronic pain (including chronic osteoarthritic pain and chronic low back pain), and with deferred programs in progressive multiple sclerosis (PrMS). These are manufactured as oral small molecule drugs and delivered via clinical and, if approved, commercial pharmaceutical channels.

products.name: PIPE-307 (M1R Antagonist Therapies)
products.description: A novel, selective, small molecule muscarinic type 1 receptor (M1R) antagonist, PIPE-307, developed for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD) and relapse-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS), in partnership with J&J for further development and commercialization. Delivered as an oral small molecule pharmaceutical product.

products.name: CTX-343 (Peripherally-Restricted LPA1R Antagonist Therapies)
products.description: A peripherally-restricted, orally bioavailable small molecule LPA1R antagonist (CTX-343) developed for potential use in peripheral fibrotic diseases. Clinical development is deferred until additional funding is obtained. Delivered as an oral small molecule drug.

products.name: Preclinical Small Molecule Drug Discovery Programs for NI&I Indications
products.description: A portfolio of internally-discovered, proprietary small molecule programs in preclinical and discovery phases, targeting neurodegenerative, inflammatory, and fibrotic diseases (NI&I indications). These programs are focused on modulating innate pathways and include, for example, a selective calpain inhibitor. Delivered as future oral small molecule drugs, pending further development and approval.

products.name: Office Leasing
products.description: Leasing of modernized, amenitized, and well-located office space in Manhattan, produced and delivered through ownership, management, and operation of office properties.

products.name: Retail Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail space in prime New York City locations, delivered through ownership and management of retail properties.

products.name: Multifamily Residential Leasing
products.description: Leasing of residential units, including both market-rate and affordable housing, in multifamily properties in New York City, managed by third-party property managers.

products.name: Empire State Building Observatory Ticket Sales
products.description: Operation and ticket sales for the Empire State Building's 86th and 102nd floor observatories, delivered through on-site visitor experiences and reservation systems.

products.name: ADHD Therapies
products.description: Prescription pharmaceutical products for the treatment of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), primarily Qelbree, a novel non-stimulant extended-release capsule, manufactured via third-party contract manufacturing and distributed through wholesalers and specialty pharmacies.

products.name: Parkinson's Disease Therapies
products.description: A portfolio of prescription drugs and devices for Parkinson's Disease, including GOCOVRI (amantadine extended-release capsules), APOKYN (apomorphine hydrochloride injection), ONAPGO (subcutaneous apomorphine infusion device), and XADAGO (safinamide), manufactured by third parties and distributed via specialty pharmacies and wholesalers.

products.name: Epilepsy Therapies
products.description: Prescription extended-release oral medications for epilepsy, including Trokendi XR (topiramate) and Oxtellar XR (oxcarbazepine), manufactured by third-party CMOs and distributed through wholesalers and pharmacies.

products.name: Migraine Prevention Therapies
products.description: Extended-release oral medication (Trokendi XR) for the preventive treatment of migraine in adolescents and adults, manufactured by third-party CMOs and distributed through wholesalers and pharmacies.

products.name: Postpartum Depression Therapies
products.description: Prescription oral medication for postpartum depression (PPD), primarily ZURZUVAE (zuranolone), a neuroactive steroid manufactured in Europe and distributed via specialty pharmacies, commercialized in partnership with Biogen.

products.name: Cervical Dystonia and Sialorrhea Therapies
products.description: Botulinum toxin B injectable (MYOBLOC) for the treatment of cervical dystonia and chronic sialorrhea in adults, manufactured by Merz in Europe and distributed to physicians and hospitals.

products.name: Research and Development of CNS Product Candidates
products.description: Development and clinical testing of novel product candidates for central nervous system (CNS) disorders, including SPN-817 (anticonvulsant for epilepsy), SPN-820 (treatment-resistant depression), and SPN-443 (ADHD), with manufacturing for clinical trials outsourced to third parties.

products.name: Out-licensing of Proprietary Technologies and Products
products.description: Licensing of proprietary formulation technologies and intellectual property to third parties for use in the development and commercialization of pharmaceutical products, generating royalty and milestone revenue.
